newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca says to buy Mogen for 46 mln stg.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca says to buy Mogen for 46 mln stg.

text.p: British drug group Zeneca Ltd said on Tuesday it would make a public offer for the entire share capital of Dutch biotechnology company Mogen at a price of 4.46 stg per share, valuing the company at 46 million stg on a fully diluted basis.
It is expected that Zeneca will make the public offer in accordance with the Dutch merger code and is expected to be completed by the end of June.
Shareholders who control 51 percent of Mogen's shares have irrevocably committed to offer and sell their shares to Zeneca at 4.46 stg a share.
Mogen is a major biotechnology firm involved in genetic modification for fungal and nematode resistence and for the production of enzymes and carbohydrates in plants.
